QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] The Heart of the Warrior
QuestInfo.0: After another circuit around the Afterlands, you return to the Land of Warriors. It seems something has gone terribly wrong with your plan to give them an extended rest!\r\n
QuestInfo.1: After another circuit around the Afterlands, you returned to the Land of Warriors. It seems something went terribly wrong with your plan to give them an extended rest!\r\n#p9400205# suggests you change night into day immediately.
QuestInfo.2: A difference in perspective led to a big misunderstanding. While you meant to make life better for everyone in the Land of Warriors, you only ended up making them miserable.\r\nYou now understand that battle is their greatest joy in life. \r\n
